identity.emotional_tone: Warm, squishy, and optimistic. Like a high-quality interactive picture book.
identity.visual_metaphor: Paper cutouts and soft stickers on a warm table.

theme_mode.rules: Light mode ONLY for kids' ease of reading. Dark mode is reserved for 'Sleepy Time' settings or high-contrast accessibility overrides if requested, but default is Light.

usage_rules: Backgrounds should never be pure white (#FFFFFF) unless it's a card/surface. Use #FFF9F0 (Warm Cream) for main screens.
Use 'Dino Green' for World 1, 'Space Blue' for World 2, 'Critter Pink' for World 3.
Primary Action Button (#FF9F1C) must be used for 'Play', 'Next', 'Go' actions.

font_family.headings: System Rounded (e.g., Arial Rounded MT Bold) or 'Fredoka' if available

rules: Headings must be rounded and heavy.
Body text minimal. Use icons + voiceover where possible.
Contrast ratio must be AA+ (3:1 for large text, 4.5:1 for body).

touch_targets.interaction_rule: All interactive elements must have at least 48x48px hit slop.

layout.safe_area: Always wrap screen content in SafeAreaView or equivalent padding.

KidButton.description: A massive, squishy button for main actions.
KidButton.style: bg-action-primary_btn rounded-full shadow-[0_4px_0_rgb(200,100,0)] active:translate-y-1 active:shadow-none h-16 justify-center items-center

WorldCard.style: bg-white rounded-3xl p-4 shadow-md border-4 border-transparent active:scale-95 transition-transform

StickerSlot.style: bg-gray-100 border-2 border-dashed border-gray-300 rounded-xl aspect-square justify-center items-center

animation.description: Bouncy, playful transitions. No linear eases.

instructions_to_main_agent:
CRITICAL: This is a React Native Expo project. Do NOT use HTML tags like
, , . Use , , .
Use 'nativewind' classes (className='...') as if it were web Tailwind, but ensure nativewind is configured. If not, use StyleSheet.
Assume 'expo-router' is used. Use <Link> or router.push().
Implement the 'Parental Gate' as a math challenge (e.g., 'What is 3 + 5?') before accessing Settings or Subscriptions.
Ensure all buttons have `activeOpacity={0.8}` or a scale animation on press.
The 'Map' is the Home Screen. It should scroll horizontally or vertically to show different worlds.
Use AsyncStorage for saving progress (unlocked levels, collected stickers).
Subscriptions are MOCKED. Just store a boolean 'isPremium' in AsyncStorage.
Data-testids: Add `testID='...'` to all TouchableOpacity/Pressable elements.
